title: The Botanical Evacuation
premise: An office of seed collectors is packing a living archive before the harbor is overrun.
opening: A radio call cuts through the harbor fog. Carry the names home.

entries.description: A steaming cup hangs above a saucer in the shop emblem.
Two colleagues photographed together beside a windswept waterfront railing.
A botanical sketch shows three broad leaves growing above a terracotta pot.
A blue compass rose surrounds a hollow central disk.
A pale leaf has a dark stem and diagonal veins.
A triangular white sail rises above a red hull.
An ochre fish faces left, its forked tail stretched to the right.
Ochre graffiti forms a tent-like arch beneath a small rust-red sun.
A red-roofed hut stands between a cypress and a shallow inlet.
A hand-drawn planning diagram connects three colored work areas in a triangular loop.
Rust-colored ribs fan outward from a shell’s narrow base.
A striped beacon tower stands below a broad yellow beam.
Short amber rays ring an orange sun.
Three blue crests break across the lower edge.
A brass key joins a hollow ring to a notched shaft.
A black gull lifts angular wings above a low horizon.
A navy anchor curls beneath a red suspension ring.
An emerald diamond encloses a smaller gold facet.
A seedling carries two green leaves above a split seed.
Snow caps a slate mountain while a small red marker sits below.
Two interlocking gold loops form a chain link.
A charcoal spiral winds clockwise around an open center.
